description:
Hi,


This is Anthony from Infojini Consulting. Hope you are doing well! 


We are Looking for Web Content developer position based in Pontiac,MI for 6 months contract position.
 

 JOB DETAILS GIVEN BELOW:-


Job Title:Web Content developer

Duration:6 Month

Location: Pontiac,MI

Client: Direct Client


Description

Produces and edits web-site content. Creates and designs graphics, animation and other multimedia objects for the County web sites. 

Develops and documents style guides keeping with design philosophy. 

Designs and implements user interface and information architecture.

Photographs and edits pictures for distribution through various media. ***** MORE ABOUT THE JOB***** Our site has thousands of pages.

The person in this role with work the customers (80 departments) to rework their areas of the site to simplify, combine, and eliminate content while refreshing 

the look/feel of each section (within the confines of the pre-developed template). 

This position is 90% web content and 10% design. Of that, it’s 70% customer support/reworking current pages/sites and 30% new development into new 

sites/applications.

***** IDEAL CANDIDATE***** Previous enterprise level site experience. 

Strong knowledge re: content organization, copyediting for usability, and optimizing for accessibility. 

Modern/clean graphic design skills with experience creating graphics for the web. 

Strong communication skills & excellent customer service.


 Required Skills
• MS Office 365
• HTML
• CSS
• Adobe CS 6
• SharePoint 2013.


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
